about: Exide Industries Limited designs, manufactures, markets, and sells lead acid batteries and accumulators in India and internationally. It offers automotive, infrastructural, genset, solar, inverter, institutional uninterrupted power supply (UPS), and submarine batteries, as well as home UPS systems, integrated power back-up systems, and e-rickshaw vehicles.
